definitions.explanation: Used to express relief that something turned out well.
A state of being lucky or blessed.

examples.japanese: {幸|さいわ}い、⟦{怪我|けが}→怪我：00787_kega⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
{幸|さいわ}い⟦な→だ：09496_da⟧⟦ことに→こと：01164_koto⟧、⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{降|ふ}らなかった→降る：00839_furu⟧。
ご⟦{多幸|たこう}→多幸：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{祈|いの}りします→祈る：01198_inoru⟧。
examples.notes: [Note: {多幸|たこう} is a formal word for happiness]

examples.japanese: {幸|さいわ}い、⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{遅延|ちえん}→遅延：06749_chien⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{軽微|けいび}→軽微：16577_keibi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦には→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}った→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧。
examples.english: Fortunately, the train delay was minor, and I made it to the meeting on time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{幸|しあわ}せ→幸せ：02368_shiawase⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The happiness of one's family is the most important thing.
examples.notes: [Note: Read as しあわせ when meaning happiness]

examples.japanese: ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{幸|さいわ}い⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦では→で：00502_de⟧⟦{測|はか}れない→測る：01977_hakaru⟧。⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦や→や：10080_ya⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦との→と：00512_to⟧⟦つながり→つながり：10380_tsunagari⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{幸|さいわ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ひとつ→ひとつ：noentry⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: A person's good fortune cannot be measured by money alone. Health and connections with others are also a great blessing.

notes:
{幸|さいわ}い is used to express fortune or luck.

AS ADVERB:
- {幸|さいわ}い (fortunately)
- {幸|さいわ}いなこと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (fortunately)
- {幸|さいわ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (luckily)

AS NOUN:
- {幸|さいわ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祈|いの}る→祈る：01198_inoru⟧ (to wish someone happiness)
- ⟦{不幸|ふこう}→不幸：03595_fukou⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{幸|さいわ}い (a blessing in disguise)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {幸|さいわ}い: fortunately (neutral to formal)
- ⟦{幸運|こううん}→幸運：02725_kouun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: luckily (emphasizes luck)
- ありがたいこと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: thankfully

FORMAL/WRITTEN:
- {幸甚|こうじん}です (I would be most grateful - very formal)
